scope: Selected Express environment and source candidates; PASS means the stated scenario passed, not all providers, client variants or public releases.

items.title: Lifecycle and selected configuration
items.verified: Actual selected-Team key binding; explicit cn-hangzhou endpoint; list/state/TTL/delete; matching-template 1 CPU/1024 MiB verified. Mismatched overrides fail and roll back.
items.limits: One existing Team and region tested; region metadata remains unknown. Cross-Team permissions and a second region were not tested.

items.title: Execution, files, recovery and failures
items.verified: 102400-byte binary SHA256 roundtrip; background job survives MCP restart; logs/results/cancel; code, execution timeout, missing sandbox and bounded Python MemoryError distinguished.
items.limits: Linux shell execution tested. Native Express code.execute is unsupported; no sandbox-wide physical OOM induced.

items.title: OCI image to usable Template
items.verified: Real public image build, ready polling, sandbox business result 385; intentional RUN exit42 build fails with diagnosis; templates deleted independently.
items.limits: Representative public image only; private registry credential paths and arbitrary images are not certified.

items.title: Persistent storage
items.verified: Private OSS real RW/RO mounts; exact mountinfo and file hash; kill and recreate persistence; owned bucket/role/policy/volume cleanup.
items.limits: OSS is the tested first storage type. Generation2 required official ossfs2/FUSE installation plus supported append-volume API.

items.title: Installation and connectivity
items.verified: Actual Cursor-generated MCP configuration invokes a cloud task; Qwen Code loads installed source Skill, discovers capabilities, creates one sandbox, returns42, file roundtrip, status and kill; independent404.
items.limits: Qwen tested with explicit reviewed MCP config and an available model. This is not an all-client certification.

items.title: Startup acceleration
items.verified: Native Template Cache official API and new CLI CRUD passed; creating→ready, list, delete→404. Three before/after create+command samples recorded.
items.limits: No native WarmPool target/cluster supplied; no workload/SLA benchmark or verified Cache fee comparison. Template Cache is not a running pool.

items.title: Cost analysis
items.verified: Read all24 pages/2311 October FC bill rows;2276 Sandbox costs grouped privately; non-Sandbox rows excluded; amounts not published.
items.limits: No historical Team/Template mapping or tags, utilization baseline or WarmPool inventory; no account-wide savings claim.

items.title: Deep pause and resume
items.verified: Actual PAUSED state, reconnect, same in-memory HTTP token, process/service, file and exact persistent mount/read-only checks.
items.limits: MicroVM generation2 tested; no all-provider or service-SLA claim.

items.title: Snapshot reuse
items.verified: Platform snapshot listing/restoration, two clones, file content and write isolation; real maintained standard contract passes.
items.limits: External VM snapshots were not supplied. Snapshot-clone mount override rejected400; no arbitrary VM import claim.

items.title: Template upgrade and rollback
items.verified: Real v1→v2→v1 business execution and independent cleanup. Cache can be explicitly managed by template ID.
items.limits: Automatic update synchronization of caches and native WarmPool was not verified; requires a version policy and target pool.

items.title: Network and credentials
items.verified: Public egress200→deny/nonzero→restore200, DNS diagnosis; model API401 without credential→200 with platform header injection, no credential in sandbox env/code.
items.limits: Old base template CA trust failed; new official v0.0.44 image passed with TLS verification. No target VPC/private service supplied.

items.title: Repository and expiring preview
items.verified: Pinned public repository fetch, dependency/test/start checks; actual preview200 then unsigned/tampered/expired403.
items.limits: Expiry implemented in the tested application HMAC layer; platform-native gateway expiry is not claimed.

items.title: Browser, desktop and takeover
items.verified: Actual desktop GUI screenshot/actions; separate VNC controller simulates operator step, Agent resumes same browser; independent state and replay timeline.
items.limits: Operator is simulated, not an actual human login. Screenshot timeline is not full-motion video. Private traffic-token validation recorded separately.

items.title: Agent framework
items.verified: Real LangGraph selected flow: one user/conversation reuses sandbox, different users separate environments/files; both resources independently404.
items.limits: Deterministic framework integration tested; no claim of a separate LLM-driven workload or multi-framework coverage.

items.title: Remote MCP
items.verified: Real HTTPS temporary hosted MCP, bearer401, separate sessions, manual tools, automatic owned-resource cleanup; ownership defects repaired and retested.
items.limits: Temporary acceptance service, not a persistent official managed production endpoint. Same credential borrowing is not cross-user isolation.

items.title: Third-party tools
items.verified: Actual filesystem MCP2026.7.10 initialize/tools/read_file, upgrade2026.8.31, same actual call, logs and process/package cleanup.
items.limits: Selected filesystem MCP requires no external service credential. Arbitrary third-party Skills were not certified.

items.title: Parallel environments
items.verified: Three real sandboxes execute exit0/7/0; failed logs/environment retained and reconnected, other resources released, final owned cleanup verified.
items.limits: Bounded three-way sample, not throughput/scale acceptance.
